description.en: Puts the DSH conversation session id on outgoing model requests so OpenCode's free tier accepts them: listens on the llm/stream waterfall and injects the session header family onto requests to opencode hosts. No API key needed. Verified against dsh 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话 id 放到出站的模型请求上，使 OpenCode 免费额度接受这些请求：监听 llm/stream waterfall，并向 opencode 主机注入会话头族。无需 API key。已在 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 上验证。
